title: Arrays
explain: Arrays are lists that store multiple values in a single variable, with each item accessible by its position (called an index, starting at 0). You can create arrays using square brackets like [1, 2, 3], and access items using array[0], array[1], etc. Arrays have useful methods like .push() to add items, .pop() to remove the last item, and .length to find how many items are inside.
exercise: Create an array of your 3 favorite colors, print the first color, add a new color to the end, and print the total number of colors.
tip: Remember that array indexing starts at 0, not 1—so the first item is always array[0], and the last item is array[array.length - 1].
